title: Crackle
identify: Lines may be darkened for decorative effect.
recognition: A connected web of fine cracks, distinct from random speckles.

confused_with.difference: Crackle and crazing can look almost identical in photos: crackle is usually intended, crazing is cracking from a glaze-body mismatch. Record the visible network; the photo cannot establish intent.
